semiconductor_relevance: High — ISC Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor testing solutions, particularly in IC chip testing sockets and related products.
summary: ISC Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of comprehensive testing solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on IC chip testing sockets and thermal fixturing. The company is dedicated to delivering high-quality, customized products that meet the evolving needs of its global customers.

regional_presence.Korea: ISC Co., Ltd. is listed on KOSDAQ and has a significant market presence in Korea, supported by active R&D investments.
